testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle template grouping by document type: tmp/obk-gallery-new/features/application/document-creation/document-creation.feature:138:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle template grouping by document type ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the metric template folder is selected ✔ And a standard metric part template's details are displayed ✔ And templates are grouped by type ✔ When the user clears Grouped by Type in the template display menu ✔ Then the template gallery displays a flat collection without type group headings ✔ And the details pane continues to display the metric part template information ✔ When the user selects Grouped by Type in the template display menu ✔ Then the gallery displays part, assembly and drawing group headings ✔ And the details pane continues to display the metric part template information
